svg.title: Yaketsuku Netsu — Scorch and Steel. Draft 1 / Yaketsuku Netsu classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 8 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Heat in the Steel forks into Searing Edge then Blade That Never Cools, or Fever Pitch then White-Hot Blood. Blistered Guard forks into Heat Finds the Seam then Nothing Left Forbidden. No paths converge. Bonuses affect existing supported tags on Yaketsuku Netsu jutsu (bloodline-keyed classification, proposed extension).

Heat in the Steel is the only fourth purchase, since the chain holds three nodes; the build suits team fights where allies share the window.","cost":4,"bonuses":{"damage":2,"increasedamagegiven":2,"increasedamagetaken":8},"finals":[{"jutsu":"Forgotten Ember Blade","row":0,"tag":"damage","label":"Damage","combat_elements":["None"],"recipient":"enemy","role":"DAMAGE","adverse":false,"base":40.0,"gain":2,"final":42.0,"calculation":"formula","supported":true,"capped_at_100":false},{"jutsu":"Forgotten Ember Blade","row":1,"tag":"increasedamagegiven","label":"Increase Damage Given","combat_elements":["None"],"recipient":"self","role":"SELF BUFF","adverse":false,"base":30.0,"gain":2,"final":32.0,"calculation":"percentage","supported":true,"capped_at_100":false},{"jutsu":"Forbidden Chakra Fury","row":0,"tag":"damage","label":"Damage","combat_elements":["None"],"recipient":"enemy","role":"DAMAGE","adverse":false,"base":40.0,"gain":2,"final":42.0,"calculation":"formula","supported":true,"capped_at_100":false},{"jutsu":"Forbidden Chakra Fury","row":1,"tag":"increasedamagetaken","label":"Increase Damage Taken","combat_elements":["None"],"recipient":"enemy","role":"ENEMY DEBUFF","adverse":false,"base":30.0,"gain":8,"final":38.0,"calculation":"percentage","supported":true,"capped_at_100":false},{"jutsu":"Chakra Shield","row":0,"tag":"absorb","label":"absorb","combat_elements":["None"],"recipient":"self","role":"SELF BUFF","adverse":false,"base":30.0,"gain":0,"final":30.0,"calculation":"percentage","supported":false,"capped_at_100":false},{"jutsu":"Chakra Shield","row":1,"tag":"shield","label":"shield","combat_elements":["None"],"recipient":"self","role":"SELF BUFF","adverse":false,"base":100.0,"gain":0,"final":100.0,"calculation":"static","supported":false,"capped_at_100":false}],"advanced_arts":["Nothing Left Forbidden"]}],"narrow_kit_exception":"Eight nodes and three Advanced Arts rather than ten and four. The kit has three supported tags on four rows (Damage x2 on Forgotten Ember Blade and Forbidden Chakra Fury; Increase Damage Given x1 on Ember Blade; Increase Damage Taken x1 on Chakra Fury); Chakra Shield's absorb and shield are not potency targets. Heat in the Steel forks into a damage route (Searing Edge \u2192 Blade That Never Cools, +6 at the two-row Damage guardrail) and a heat route (Fever Pitch \u2192 White-Hot Blood, +10 on the single self row); Blistered Guard \u2192 Heat Finds the Seam \u2192 Nothing Left Forbidden is a single chain on the kit's only enemy debuff (+8). A fourth route would need a fourth tag the kit does not have. A second Hidden Art under Blistered Guard was rejected: a +2 Damage node is a twin of Searing Edge, and a +2 or +3 Increase Damage Given node twins Fever Pitch and opens a second path toward the heat maximum. The consequence is that Heat in the Steel sits in every legal full build and the exposure route's fourth purchase is always Heat in the Steel, while Burst and Heat each have two fourth-purchase choices. Three distinct complete builds exist, one per Advanced Art, plus three no-Advanced hybrids.","design_notes":["Node split: 2 Foundations, 3 Hidden Arts, 3 Advanced Arts. Heat in the Steel (Damage +1 on both attacks, Increase Damage Given +2 on Ember Blade's heat; 3 of 4 rows) forks into Searing Edge \u2192 Blade That Never Cools (Damage +2/+3) and Fever Pitch \u2192 White-Hot Blood (IDG +3/+5). Blistered Guard \u2192 Heat Finds the Seam \u2192 Nothing Left Forbidden (IDT +2/+3/+3, capstone also Damage +1) is a separate chain. Each Advanced Art is 3 BP deep; any two cost 5 or 6 BP, so a build holds at most one.","Flats by coverage: Damage reaches 2 rows, so the route totals +6 (1+2+3; 40\u219246 on both attacks), the Lycanthropy shape at the guardrail. Increase Damage Given is one self row and takes Taiyo Kami's single-row 2+3+5 = +10 shape (its DDT chain): 30\u219240%. Increase Damage Taken is one enemy row but amplifies every non-pierce source, allies included, so its chain is held to 2+3+3 = +8 (30\u219238%), one above Taiyo Kami's single-row IDT peak; the capstone's +1 Damage stays under Searing Edge.","Interactions: Ember Blade's heat row is Bukijutsu-filtered but element-less, so the filter is not binding: it matches every element-less hit of any stat type (basic attacks, weapons, non-elemental jutsu) and excludes only elemental damage of a non-Bukijutsu stat type; it adds power/100 \u00d7 the staged base per hit and skips pierce. The Bukijutsu IDG passive (22 + 0.15/level) multiplies in its own stage. Chakra Fury's exposure row lists four stat types, no element: every non-pierce hit counts.","Delivery and uptime: both attacks are OTHER_USER single-target casts at range 4 for 60 AP (Ember Blade cooldown 6, Chakra Fury cooldown 7). The heat is a SELF-target row realized on the caster at cast time; the exposure is INHERIT on the struck enemy. Both last 2 rounds, so Ember Blade then Chakra Fury on consecutive rounds overlaps the windows for one round. The Damage route has no uptime dependency; the heat and exposure routes are worth what lands inside a 2-round window.","Fourth purchases and allocations: Burst \u2192 Blistered Guard (exposure 32%) or Fever Pitch (heat 35%); Heat \u2192 Blistered Guard (exposure 32%) or Searing Edge (attacks 43); Exposure \u2192 Heat in the Steel only. No-Advanced hybrids: 01,02,04,06 (attacks 43, heat 35%, exposure 32%), 01,02,06,07 (43, 32%, 35%) and 01,04,06,07 (41, 35%, 35%). The validator enumerates 8 legal full allocations; all 8 are numerically non-dominated and every node appears in at least one; 3 of the 8 hold no Advanced Art.","Row-weighted value: 01,02,03,04 is the strongest full allocation at 17 (Damage +6 on two rows, IDG +5), then 01,02,03,06 and 01,02,04,05 at 16; Lycanthropy peaks at 20 on five rows and Taiyo Kami at 31 on nine. Lowest-value purchase by row weight is Blistered Guard (+2 on one row), accepted as the exposure root in the Taiyo Kami single-tag Foundation shape; it is also the cheapest way for the two 01-rooted builds to touch the enemy debuff."],"risks":["Classification: no row carries an element, so the tree needs the proposed bloodline-keyed label (Yaketsuku Netsu); under the current resolver all 4 supported rows fall back to None, which also reaches every non-elemental row on any jutsu the player casts (35 census bloodlines carry None rows). Whether NORMAL/SPECIAL/EVENT jutsu collide is unverified.","Heat breadth (user-owned value): White-Hot Blood puts Ember Blade's self Increase Damage Given at 40% for 2 rounds per 6-round cooldown, on every element-less hit including weapon and basic attacks and normal jutsu, on top of the Bukijutsu IDG passive (22 + 0.15/level, multiplicative stage) and any main-tree or gear IDG. BATTLE_TAG_STACKING is on at the pin. +8 (2+3+3) is the fallback.","Exposure breadth: Nothing Left Forbidden puts Chakra Fury's Increase Damage Taken at 38% on the target for 2 rounds; the row lists four stat types and no element, so every non-pierce hit from allies, weapons and normal jutsu is amplified, and the realized value in team fights scales with ally output. Held to +8 for that reason; +7 (2+2+3) is the Taiyo Kami ceiling if the user prefers it.","Universal opener: every legal full build contains Heat in the Steel because the exposure chain has three nodes. A mirrored layout (IDT + Damage root with the heat chain apart) only moves the universal node to the other root; the brief's preference for no mandatory opener cannot be met on four rows without a duplicate-tag filler node.","Damage is formula-calculated (sqrt stat scaling: Ember Blade on Bukijutsu / Speed, Strength; Chakra Fury on Highest) and then multiplied by the Bukijutsu IDG passive, the kit's own buffs and any exposure on the target, so +6 raw power is not linear +6 damage; realized value depends on stats. Both attacks need a target in range 4 for the heat row to be cast at all. No combat simulation.","Unsupported rows and modes: Chakra Shield's absorb 30% and shield 100 receive nothing, so the tree cannot serve the kit's defence; the 5% reflect passive and the Ninjutsu-filtered Increase Damage Taken passive on the bearer are not jutsu rows. Skill-tree and bloodline effects are skipped in ranked PvP / sparring at the pin.","Uptime: the heat and exposure routes are 2-round windows on 60 AP casts with cooldowns 6 and 7, so their value depends on fitting hits inside them; alternating the two attacks gives one round with both active per cycle. Whether the buff rows are realized when the hit misses or is prevented was not verified (SELF rows are realized at cast time; INHERIT rows follow the action's target resolution)."],"progression":{"currency":"Bloodright Point","abbreviation":"BP","acquired_with":"silver","acquisition_cap":4,"node_cost":1,"silver_price":null,"ownership_gate":"current bloodline","separate_from_normal_skill_points":true},"evaluation_level":25,"game_source_pin":"16498fd776fad9c91e4b84efed4380fe3a487050","snapshot":{"public_kit_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","hidden_kit_snapshot":"2026-09-30"},"audit":{"available_skills":8,"foundation_count":2,"hidden_art_count":3,"advanced_art_count":3,"bloodright_point_cap":4,"cost_per_skill":1,"maximum_advanced_arts":1,"minimum_two_advanced_cost":5,"maximum_parents_per_node":1,"maximum_depth":3,"legal_allocations_by_size":{"0":1,"1":2,"2":4,"3":7,"4":8},"full_budget_allocations":8,"non_dominated_full_allocations":8,"all_nodes_in_non_dominated_builds":true,"nodes_absent_from_non_dominated_builds":[],"maximum_tag_bonuses":{"damage":6,"increasedamagegiven":10,"increasedamagetaken":8},"supported_rows_in_kit":4,"supported_rows_by_tag":{"damage":2,"increasedamagegiven":1,"increasedamagetaken":1},"tags_targeted_by_tree":["damage","increasedamagegiven","increasedamagetaken"],"supported_tags_in_kit_not_targeted":[],"revision":"Draft 1 / Yaketsuku Netsu classification / forked tree","source_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","limits":["Proposed potency classification behavior; not implemented or verified in the live engine.","All existing supported tags of Yaketsuku Netsu jutsu inherit Yaketsuku Netsu potency eligibility; original combat elements and target scopes stay intact.","Every matching row on a jutsu receives each matching modifier; repeated rows are counted separately.","Damage values are raw power, not final-damage percentages; percentage-valued tags are capped at 100.","Afterburn is an enemy debuff: for its existing duration, damage the target takes causes extra Afterburn damage at its percentage (60% cap per hit). It is not itself a damage instance; downstream instances were not simulated.","Unsupported tags (e.g. wound, shield, stun, pierce, absorb, poison, drain, summon) receive no bonuses.","No combat simulation. Budget and numerical non-dominance checks do not establish equal combat strength.","Main-tree effects, bloodline passives, equipment, AP, uptime and modifier delivery are outside this audit."]},"legal_full_budget_builds":[{"ids":["01","02","03","04"],"bonuses":{"damage":6,"increasedamagegiven":5}},{"ids":["01","02","03","06"],"bonuses":{"damage":6,"increasedamagegiven":2,"increasedamagetaken":2}},{"ids":["01","02","04","05"],"bonuses":{"damage":3,"increasedamagegiven":10}},{"ids":["01","02","04","06"],"bonuses":{"damage":3,"increasedamagegiven":5,"increasedamagetaken":2}},{"ids":["01","02","06","07"],"bonuses":{"damage":3,"increasedamagegiven":2,"increasedamagetaken":5}},{"ids":["01","04","05","06"],"bonuses":{"damage":1,"increasedamagegiven":10,"increasedamagetaken":2}},{"ids":["01","04","06","07"],"bonuses":{"damage":1,"increasedamagegiven":5,"increasedamagetaken":5}},{"ids":["01","06","07","08"],"bonuses":{"damage":2,"increasedamagegiven":2,"increasedamagetaken":8}}]}

g.text: Draft 1 / Yaketsuku Netsu classification / forked tree · Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Every Yaketsuku Netsu jutsu: existing supported tags qualify; combat scope stays unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Blade That Never Cools path + Blistered Guard
Nothing Left Forbidden path + Heat in the Steel
IDG: Increase Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Proposed whole-kit potency classification. Current effect-element matching alone does not provide this inheritance.
8 legal four-skill allocations · 3 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
